query-docs

Search documentation for a specific library using semantic search. Returns relevant code examples, API references, and explanations.

POST/mcp/tools/query-docs

Overview​

The query-docs tool performs vector-based semantic search across indexed library documentation. It understands the meaning of your query, not just keywords, so it can find relevant results even when exact terms don't match.

Two-step pattern

You must call resolve-library first to get the library ID, unless you already know it.

Parameters​

libraryIdstringrequired

The library ID obtained from resolve-library (e.g., /vercel/next.js, react, hono)

querystringrequired

The question or task you need help with. Be specific for better results.

limitnumber

Maximum results to return (1-10, default 5)

tokensstring

Response format: full, compact, code-only, or summary

Query Tips​

Good Queries​

✓ "How to set up authentication with JWT"
✓ "Server component data fetching patterns"
✓ "Form validation with error messages"
✓ "useEffect cleanup function best practices"

Poor Queries​

✗ "auth" (too vague)
✗ "help" (not specific)
✗ "how do I do the thing" (unclear)
✗ "react" (library name, not a question)

Response Formats​

FormatTokensBest For
full~5,000Debugging, exploration
compact~2,000Normal usage (recommended)
code-only~1,000Quick code examples
summary~500Check if results exist

Example Usage​

Basic Query​

AI queries Next.js documentation
→ User: "How do I create API routes in Next.js?"

→ AI calls query-docs
   libraryId: "nextjs"
   query: "how to create API routes"

Result:

1. Route Handlers (relevance: 0.89)
   Route Handlers allow you to create custom request handlers...

   ```typescript
   export async function GET(request: Request) {
     return Response.json({ message: 'Hello' })
}
   ```

Code-Only Response​

{
  "name": "query-docs",
  "arguments": {
    "libraryId": "react",
    "query": "useEffect cleanup function",
    "tokens": "code-only"
  }
}

Returns only the code blocks, minimal prose:

useEffect(() => {
  const subscription = dataSource.subscribe();
  return () => {
    subscription.unsubscribe();
  };
}, [dataSource]);

Compact Response​

{
  "name": "query-docs",
  "arguments": {
    "libraryId": "hono",
    "query": "middleware authentication",
    "limit": 3,
    "tokens": "compact"
  }
}

Response Schema​

interface QueryDocsResponse {
  success: boolean;
  libraryId: string;
  libraryName: string;
  version: string;
  query: string;
  resultCount: number;
  results: Array<{
    title: string;
    content: string;
    contentType: 'prose' | 'code' | 'mixed';
    sourceFile: string;
    relevanceScore: number; // 0-1
  }>;
}

Full Example Response​

{
  "success": true,
  "libraryId": "nextjs",
  "libraryName": "Next.js",
  "version": "15.0.0",
  "query": "how to create API routes",
  "resultCount": 5,
  "results": [
    {
      "title": "Route Handlers",
      "content": "Route Handlers allow you to create custom request handlers for a given route using the Web Request and Response APIs.\n\n```typescript\nexport async function GET(request: Request) {\n  return Response.json({ message: 'Hello' })\n}\n```",
      "contentType": "mixed",
      "sourceFile": "app/building-your-application/routing/route-handlers.mdx",
      "relevanceScore": 0.89
    },
    {
      "title": "Dynamic Route Segments",
      "content": "You can access dynamic route segments...",
      "contentType": "mixed",
      "sourceFile": "app/building-your-application/routing/dynamic-routes.mdx",
      "relevanceScore": 0.76
    }
  ]
}

AI Conversation Example​

Real-world conversation
User:
I'm getting an error with React hooks in a server component

AI:
Let me search the React documentation for information about hooks
and server components.

→ Calling query-docs
   libraryId: "react"
   query: "hooks server components limitations"

AI:
Based on the documentation, React hooks cannot be used in Server
Components because hooks require client-side interactivity.

The docs recommend these patterns:

1. Move hooks to Client Components using 'use client'
2. Pass data as props from Server to Client Components
3. Use server-only data fetching patterns

Error Handling​

ErrorCauseSolution
libraryId is requiredMissing library IDCall resolve-library first
Library not foundInvalid library IDUse resolve-library to find valid ID
Library not yet indexedLibrary still processingWait and retry later
No resultsQuery doesn't matchTry different search terms

Notes​

  • Results are ranked by semantic similarity, not keyword matching
  • Each result includes the source file for reference
  • Large documentation libraries may have more relevant results
  • The tokens parameter helps manage response size for token efficiency
  • Queries are processed using vector embeddings for conceptual matching

Related Tools​

resolve-library

Find library IDs before querying documentation

get-library-info

Check library metadata and coverage

list-libraries

Browse all available libraries
